entries.title: Getting started
entries.summary: Your quick reference for races, skills and equipment.

sections.title: Open the guide
lines: Press F8 in the world, or use Guide on the Tensura status screen or the guide button in the pause menu. The key can be changed in Controls.

sections.title: Find what you need
lines: Search by name, ability, damage type or requirement. Categories narrow the results. Scroll each panel independently; use the arrows to return to earlier pages. Ctrl+F focuses search.

sections.title: Read the numbers
lines: Values are defaults. Server settings, mastery and other bonuses can change them. Skill pages list the damage type; support moves do not deal damage.

entries.title: Heavenly Restriction lineage
entries.summary: Choose Fettered Human at reincarnation. Difficulty: Hard. The lineage keeps your human appearance.

sections.title: Starting resources
lines: 1,500–2,000 aura and 50–100 magicules. Chained is granted at birth and retained through evolution; starting aura is not multiplied.

sections.title: Evolution requirements
lines: Tempered Vessel: 100,000 total EP; 1 mastered Battlewills; Chained 20%.
Unshackled: 500,000 total EP; 2 mastered Battlewills; Chained 40%.
Heavenly Restricted: 2,000,000 total EP; 3 mastered Battlewills; Chained 60%.
Heavenbreaker: 8,000,000 total EP; 4 mastered Battlewills; Chained 100%.

sections.title: Progression
lines: Use Tensura’s race evolution menu. EP requirements check the total shown in Status. Hunter’s Recovery is granted at Unshackled; Apex Renewal at Heavenly Restricted; Sovereign Rebirth at Heavenbreaker.

sections.title: Racial health bonuses
lines: Tempered Vessel: +100 HP / +400 SHP. Unshackled: +300 HP / +1,600 SHP.
Heavenly Restricted: +600 HP / +3,600 SHP. Heavenbreaker: +1,000 HP / +6,600 SHP. Each stage replaces the old racial bonuses.

sections.title: Starting skill rolls
lines: Skills with magicule-cost abilities or target-skill stealing/copying are excluded from Fettered Human’s starting rolls. Pride is exempt; Creator and recorded derived skills remain allowed.

entries.title: Chained
entries.summary: The lineage’s Unique Skill trades magical growth and unrestricted learning for aura and physical combat.

sections.title: Always active while owned
lines: Later maximum-aura gains receive 5× growth; existing magicule capacity is retained but cannot grow. EP gains split 90% aura / 10% magicules; the blocked magicule share is not redirected.
Retain up to 1 magicule per second and convert the remaining computed regeneration, including biome and sleep bonuses, into aura.

Learn Battlewills, resistances/nullifications, reincarnation skills and their derived skills, and lineage recovery skills. Blocked skills remain visible but cannot finish learning. Resistances use their configured acquisition cost in current aura.

sections.title: Toggle: Martial Supremacy
lines: Battlewill learning/mastery +9; resistance learning +19. Battlewill-sourced attacks deal 5× damage; other Physical hits deal 3×. These branches do not stack. Numeric Battlewill buffs receive 3× effectiveness; Aura Sword is excluded.

sections.title: Mastered: Broken Limit
lines: Always active when mastered. Your hits ignore dodge and lower Nullification to Resistance, and Resistance to nothing.

sections.title: In slot: Unerring Body
lines: 10% damage reduction, 100% projectile dodge and 25% other dodge, subject to native bypass rules. Immune to Fear, Slowness, Burden and Haki effects.

sections.title: Press: Severance Rush
lines: Aim and teleport up to 16 blocks, including in the air; stop before the aimed enemy. Physical damage along a 3-block radius and at the 4-block arrival. Cost: 2% current aura. Cooldown: 1 second.
Base damage: path 1.5 × √A + W; arrival 3 × √A + W. A is the base aura payment; W is the held weapon contribution. Weapon enchantments and engravings apply.

entries.title: Unbound
entries.summary: Chained automatically evolves into this Ultimate when you are Heavenbreaker, fully master Chained, and become a True Hero or True Demon Lord.

sections.title: Retained pact
lines: Retains Chained’s restrictions, aura growth and regeneration conversion. Presets and progress carry over.

sections.title: Improved combat
lines: Toggle: 8× Battlewill damage or 5× other Physical damage; 4× numeric Battlewill buffs except Aura Sword. The damage branches remain separate.
In slot: 30% damage reduction, 100% projectile dodge and 50% other dodge. Retains Fear, Slowness, Burden and Haki immunity.
Mastered Broken Limit retains resistance degradation and dodge bypass, and makes your attacks critical hits.

sections.title: Severance Rush
lines: The same 16-block aim teleport and Physical path/arrival formulas as Chained. Cost: 2% current aura. Cooldown: 1 second. Held weapon effects apply.

sections.title: Counter
lines: Press to hold a defensive stance for 3 seconds with movement speed 0. The first eligible enemy hit is negated and releases a terrain-piercing slash toward the attacker, hitting other enemies along its path.
Cost: 10% current aura on entry. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Press again to cancel early for free.
Physical base damage: 10 × negated damage + 6 × √A + W. The released weapon’s damage, enchantments and engravings apply; toggle bonuses and critical hits then apply.

entries.title: Schema
entries.summary: A Battlewill with a customizable six-effect tree. Learn: 1,000 points. Master: 2,000 points.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press Build to open the tree. Choose Add Mito, Add Str. or Add Regen; select a slot to move or remove it. Apply saves; Close discards unapplied edits. Toggle Schema to activate the saved tree.

sections.title: Effects per stack
lines: Strength: +5 base attack damage; +2% damage taken.
Regenerative: +20% HP/SHP healing received; +5% aura and magicule costs. Healing bonuses apply once and respect native limits.

sections.title: Slot order and mastery
lines: Positive weights start at 100%, 50%, 25%, 12.5%, 6.25%, 3.125%. Every 400 mastery makes another slot full strength, reaching all six at 2,000. All effects share that order; drawbacks always stay full strength.
Chained/Unbound boosts positive Battlewill bonuses once; drawbacks are not boosted.

sections.title: Training
lines: Qualifying aura recovery, Strength hits and Regenerative healing share one mastery gain every 30 seconds. Idle full reserves, editing and toggling grant no training. The timer and build persist after saving.

entries.title: Air Walk
entries.summary: A Battlewill evolution of Air Float / Air Flight.

sections.title: Learn
lines: Master your permanent Air Float, then complete the new learning entry in the Battlewill menu.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press to enable free flight using aura. Press again to stop; stopping is free even with empty aura.
Cost: 30 aura to activate and 30 aura per second actually flying. Mastery halves both to 15. No magicule cost or cooldown.

entries.title: Instant Transmission
entries.summary: A Battlewill evolution of Instant Move for coordinate self-teleportation.

sections.title: Learn
lines: Master your permanent Instant Move, then complete its evolution’s learning entry.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press to enter X, Y and Z, then choose Warp. Only you travel, within the current dimension; it does not create portals.
Charge: 100 ticks / 5 seconds; instant at mastery. Cost: 10 aura per block of 3D distance, halved to 5 at mastery. Opening the menu is free.

sections.title: Limits
lines: Native spatial blocks still apply. Invalid or unfunded requests do not start a cast. Losing the skill, dying, logging out or changing dimension cancels a pending cast; a started cast has already paid.

entries.title: Aura recovery skills
entries.summary: Toggle a recovery skill to heal with aura. Only your strongest toggled tier works; full reserves cost nothing.

sections.title: Hunter’s Recovery
lines: Restore 4 HP per second, or 8 mastered, at 20 aura per base HP.

sections.title: Apex Renewal
lines: Restore missing HP every half second. Cost: 30 aura per base HP, or 20 mastered.

sections.title: Sovereign Rebirth
lines: Restore HP and SHP every half second. Cost: 30 aura per HP / 10 per SHP, or 20 / 5 mastered. Can prevent ordinary fatal damage while funded; native bypass and suppression rules still apply.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Granted by the relevant hunter or Heavenly Restriction evolutions. Earlier recovery skills remain available, but do not heal in parallel.

entries.title: Inverted Spear of Heaven
entries.summary: A rare weapon from ominous trial vault loot, with the same attack stats as a Hihiirokane Sword.

sections.title: Stats and obtaining
lines: 80 total ordinary player attack damage; 1.6 attack speed. Rare 2% additional ominous-vault reward. Regular vaults do not drop it.

sections.title: Nullification engraving
lines: Weapon hits instantly shatter barriers, remove skill status effects, and prevent skill activation for 2 seconds. The weapon can attack Spiritual Entities.
Held main-hand attacks, Severance Rush and Counter carry the engraving. Spiritual contact bypasses the spiritual-body Physical reduction, while armor, resistance, dodge and PvP rules still apply.

entries.title: Aegir, Lord of the Abyss
entries.summary: Aegir, Lord of the Abyss is an Ultimate Skill for water refraction, projectile redirection and an expanding tidal shock front. Mirrorsea changes the origins and reach of its other arts.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Mastered Scarlet Deluge + Mirrorbound; 2M total EP

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 100% Water boost, 75% Light boost and 0.5 knockback resistance. Ordinary elemental sources use their strongest contribution; Godly boosts remain separate.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Refracted Harpoon · Aura cost: 7,000 · Cooldown: 5 s · Raw damage: 1,600; 2,200 with Mirrorsea
2. Mirrorsea · Aura cost: 12,000 · Cooldown: 16 s · Raw damage: —; reflected shots keep their attack type
3. Sovereign Breaker · Aura cost: 20,000 · Cooldown: 24 s · Raw damage: 2,100; 3,000 when empowered
Mastery increases damage up to 1.5× before native handling. Art hits use native level-1 resistance penetration; native defenses, barriers and hit immunity remain relevant.

sections.title: Refracted Harpoon
lines: Target cap: 8 distinct enemies per cast
Fire a caustic water spear along your aim. Solid blocks stop each ray; fluids do not.

sections.title: Mirrorsea
lines: Damage type: None — projectile redirection / setup
Create a stationary caustic basin surrounded by six hovering glass lenses. Incoming hostile and unowned projectiles inside it turn toward their sender, or reverse if unowned.

sections.title: Sovereign Breaker
lines: Normal reach: 18 blocks from the caster
Launch a circular shock front that expands over two seconds, fading out over the following 0.4 seconds. Damage follows its narrow moving rim; the entire inner disk is not continuously damaging.

entries.title: Aion, God of Causality
entries.summary: Aion, God of Causality is a Godly skill built around spatial precision, battlefield control and a personal HP/SHP/energy rewind with a safe recorded position. Its active arts use magicules and space elemental damage.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Mastered Myths Ultimate, True Hero or True Demon Lord, 12M total EP

sections.title: Passive
lines: Adds 45 physical barrier, 45 magic barrier, 0.75 knockback resistance and 1,200 native Multilayer Barrier capacity. The latter uses Tensura’s existing barrier HUD.

sections.title: Active
lines: Worldline Sever · Magicule cost: 2,400 to start; 1,200 per additional 0.5 seconds · Cooldown: 4 seconds after channel ends · Range / area: 80-block beam, up to 8 targets per pulse, 6-second maximum · Base damage: 1,200 per 0.5 seconds
Event Horizon · Magicule cost: 10,000 · Cooldown: 16 seconds · Range / area: 64-block cursor placement; 24-block pull, 10-block damage radius; 10 seconds · Base damage: 700 per second
Causal Reversal · Magicule cost: 12,000 to record; free return · Cooldown: 1 second to recast; 25 seconds after manual or automatic return · Range / area: Personal checkpoint, 20-second window

Genesis Verdict · Magicule cost: 28,000 · Cooldown: 45 seconds · Range / area: 64-block mob/player acquisition; 20 blasts, 3.75 / 4.5-block radius each · Base damage: 480 / 600 per hole; 9,600 / 12,000 total

sections.title: Worldline Sever
lines: Hold the assigned skill key to channel a gold-white spatial beam that follows the current crosshair direction. It pierces up to eight eligible enemies per pulse, passes through water and lava, and stops at solid block collision shapes (including solid waterlogged blocks).

sections.title: Event Horizon
lines: Place a gravity domain with a dark core, counter-rotating accretion bands and Tensura’s native Gravity magic circle. Enemies within 24 blocks are pulled toward the core; only enemies within the 10-block inner radius take space damage each second.

sections.title: Causal Reversal
lines: The first press costs 12,000 magicules and places a visible clockwork checkpoint, recording position, HP, SHP, aura and magicules after paying that initial cast cost. Press again after the one-second recast delay to return for no cost, even with no magicules remaining.

sections.title: Genesis Verdict
lines: Summon twenty miniature black holes at scattered airborne positions around the mob or player under your crosshair, within 64 blocks. A valid, visible enemy is required.

entries.title: Anansi, Lord of Schemes
entries.summary: Its damage follows the threads and the shape you construct.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Mastered Threadweaver + Rune Smith; 2M total EP

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 100% Space boost, 100% Earth boost and 30% movement speed. Only the strongest ordinary source applies per elemental attribute; Godly bonuses remain separate.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Fate Stitch · Aura cost: 5,000 per anchor · Cooldown: 2 s · Raw damage: 1,300 per thread contact
2. Puppet Passage · Aura cost: 3,500 · Cooldown: 5 s
3. Checkmate Loom · Aura cost: 22,000 · Cooldown: 24 s · Raw damage: 2,800 Space, then 1,900 Earth
Damage is before mastery, elemental boosts and native defenses. Mastery increases damage up to 1.5×.

sections.title: Fate Stitch
lines: Place a hovering runic spider anchor at the aimed location. Each anchor arms after 0.6 seconds.

sections.title: Puppet Passage
lines: Aim along a visible anchor to travel to it. Your current momentum is preserved, and that anchor moves to your previous position, rebuilding its links and rearming after 0.6 seconds.

sections.title: Checkmate Loom
lines: Damage type: Space elemental, then Earth elemental
Requirement: At least two active anchors
After 1.2 seconds, enemies inside the triangle or its narrow perimeter suffer 2,800 raw Space damage. With two anchors, the affected region is a 3.5-block corridor around their connecting segment.

entries.title: Black Flame
entries.summary: Black Flame is a Unique Skill inspired by Nu Udra. It uses visible oil tentacles to pull targets into burning ground.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Additional status damage: Black Burn — tensura:blackflame

sections.title: Passive
lines: While toggled on, gain 8 armor, 50% melee attack and 50% flame boost. Fire-tagged damage is resisted while the passive is enabled, preserving its fire-protection utility without a lingering potion.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Oil Lash · Aura: 550 · Cooldown: 3 s · Raw opening damage: 260
2. Blackflame Ignition · Aura: 1,600 · Cooldown: 7 s · Raw opening damage: 350
Damage calculation: multiply the listed base values by 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, up to 1.50×. Elemental boosts, defenses, barriers, and situational modifiers also apply.

sections.title: Oil Lash
lines: Additional status damage: Black Burn — tensura:blackflame
Lash up to 4 enemies in a forward fan within 14 blocks and pull them toward you. Each lash has a synced three-dimensional tapered tentacle with a dark body and glowing orange bands.

sections.title: Blackflame Ignition
lines: Additional status damage: Black Burn — tensura:blackflame
Additional status damage: Black Burn: tensura:blackflame (details)
Ignite valid owned pools for six seconds. Each affects a 3-block radius; overlapping pools cannot damage one enemy twice in a pulse.

entries.title: Demeter, Lady of Sanctuary
entries.summary: Demeter, Lady of Sanctuary is an Ultimate Skill focused on ice orchard, one-use allied rescue seeds and delayed crystal blooms.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Synthesis: master both ingredients; 2M total EP

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 200% increased natural SHP regeneration, 100% Water boost and 0.6 knockback resistance. Water boost also strengthens native Ice attacks where they use the shared Water/Ice attribute.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Winter Orchard · Aura: 12,000 · Cooldown: 20 s · Raw damage: 500 per enemy pulse
3. Winter Harvest · Aura: 20,000 · Cooldown: 24 s · Raw damage: 1,400; 2,200 when consuming a live orchard
Damage listed here is before native combat handling and uses 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. EP never multiplies their damage.

sections.title: Winter Orchard
lines: Damage type: Ice elemental against enemies; allied healing has no damage type

Plant a twelve-block-radius crystal orchard within 32 blocks for twelve seconds. Each second, heal up to eight allies for 10% maximum HP and 10% maximum SHP, and strike up to eight visible enemies for ice damage with native Chill II for two seconds.

sections.title: Perennial Seed
lines: Plant one rescue seed on yourself and eligible allies within sixteen blocks, up to eight recipients total. Placing a seed cleanses ordinary Poison, Wither, Chill and Webbed effects.

sections.title: Winter Harvest
lines: Raw damage: 1,400; 2,200 when consuming a live orchard

Select up to six enemy positions within twelve blocks of your orchard, or an aimed location within 32 blocks if no orchard is active. Consume the live orchard to empower the blooms and immediately restore eligible allies within twelve blocks for 20% maximum HP and SHP.

entries.title: Frostbound Colossus
entries.summary: Frostbound Colossus is a Unique Skill inspired by Jin Dahaad. It combines avalanche impacts, ice capture, and a defensive carapace.

sections.title: Passive
lines: While toggled on, gain 20 armor, 36 physical barrier, 13.5 magic barrier, one knockback resistance and 50% water-element boost. Tensura classifies ice under water for this boost.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Avalanche Crash · Aura: 700 · Cooldown: 3 s · Raw opening damage: 320
2. Glacial Prison · Aura: 1,100 · Cooldown: 7 s · Raw opening damage: 180
Damage calculation: multiply the listed base values by 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, up to 1.50×. Elemental boosts, defenses, barriers, and situational modifiers also apply.

sections.title: Avalanche Crash
lines: Aim at a visible enemy up to 16 blocks away, or at the endpoint if no enemy is selected. Damage enemies in a 4-block radius and launch them upward and outward, respecting knockback resistance.

sections.title: Glacial Prison
lines: Aim at one visible hostile within 20 blocks. Deal the listed hit damage, then apply Tensura’s native Frost effect for up to 4 seconds, subject to its rank and resistance checks.

entries.title: Godly Skills
entries.summary: Godly is Tensura Myths’ skill tier above Ultimate. It appears as Godly in Tensura’s skill menu, alongside the six original categories.

sections.title: Ascend
lines: Master a combination Ultimate, become a True Hero or True Demon Lord and reach 12M total EP. Use Skills → Godly → Ascension.
Choose Aion directly; Thoth also needs mastered Rune Smith, and Lugh also needs mastered Threadweaver.

sections.title: Always-active classification passives
lines: Divine Authority: +35% damage against targets without a learned Godly skill.
Absolute Penetration: your damage bypasses resistance/nullification skills and corresponding resistance attributes. It does not remove every other defense.
Interference Immunity: non-Godly magic interference cannot suppress the owner.

entries.title: Janus, Lord of Crossroads
entries.summary: Janus, Lord of Crossroads is an Ultimate Skill focused on linked gates, opposing spatial blades and safe displacement.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Synthesis: master both ingredients; 2M total EP

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 35% movement speed, 30% attack speed, 0.5 knockback resistance and 100% Space boost. Threshold Dominion rewards movement and spatial offense.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Twin Gates · Aura: 4,000 placement / 400 transit · Cooldown: 2 s
2. Parallax Snare · Aura: 9,000 · Cooldown: 8 s · Raw damage: 1,900
3. Crossroads Edict · Aura: 16,000 · Cooldown: 18 s · Raw damage: 1,700
Damage listed here is before native combat handling and uses 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. EP never multiplies their damage.

sections.title: Twin Gates
lines: Resource cost: 4,000 aura placement / 400 aura transit
First cast costs 4,000 aura and places a gate at your feet and a second safe point up to 48 blocks along the aimed route. The pair lasts thirty seconds.

sections.title: Parallax Snare
lines: Mark a point within 48 blocks. Opposing spatial blades close around a seven-block radius and strike after 0.8 seconds, for 1,900 raw Space damage.

sections.title: Crossroads Edict
lines: Choose a field center within 32 blocks. Up to six visible enemies within ten blocks are displaced to their mirrored horizontal positions across the center.

entries.title: Lugh, God of Skills
entries.summary: Lugh, God of Skills is a Godly Skill for analysing, reconstructing and combining combat techniques. Its persistent Skill Bank and three bound techniques determine the forms and damage types of its attacks, while Countermand seals one enemy technique temporarily.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Mastered combination Ultimate + mastered Threadweaver; true awakening; 12M total EP

sections.title: Classification passives
lines: Lugh ownership automatically grants Divine Authority, Absolute Penetration and Interference Immunity. These provide +35% damage against non-Godly owners, resistance/nullification bypass for your own damage, and protection from non-Godly-origin Magic Interference.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Damage type: None — learning, cooldown support and technique analysis

Gain +49 native learning points and +49 native mastery points per gain, 35% movement speed, and 50% shorter cooldown recovery for other skills. The point bonuses are flat additions to Tensura’s native gain attributes, rather than percentage multipliers.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Skill Bank · Magicule cost: Free · Cooldown: None
2. Reconstructed Art · Magicule cost: 10,000; selection/binding are free · Cooldown: 4 s · Damage: 3,500–6,000 raw
4. Grand Synthesis · Magicule cost: 30,000 · Cooldown: 40 s · Damage: Three bound attacks at 1.6× their reconstruction damage
Mastery scales damaging arts by 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. Native elemental boosts, barriers, hit immunity, authority and PvP rules remain relevant.

sections.title: Skill Bank
lines: Damage type: None — technique storage and selection
Collection range: 64 blocks around the user of a damaging technique, while All-Skilled is enabled
Press the assigned key to open the searchable bank directly. Crouching is not required; crouching also opens the same menu.

sections.title: Reconstructed Art
lines: Damage type: Active bound entry: physical, elemental or generic magic
Use the technique bound to the active Art slot in one of three distinct geometries:

sections.title: Countermand
lines: Damage type: None — temporary activation seal
Aim at an enemy with a recent damaging technique. Seal that one originating non-Godly ability, stopping new activations through native skill events and Tensura's activation checks.

sections.title: Grand Synthesis
lines: Damage type: The three bound entries, in slot order

Snapshot all three bound entries into a fixed, warned formation. Three floating rune tablets assemble into the corresponding armaments, each striking for 1.6× its recorded raw damage before mastery and native handling.

entries.title: Mirrorbound
entries.summary: Mirrorbound is a Unique Skill focused on splitting light attacks and timed projectile reflection.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 50% Light boost, 25% attack speed and 20% movement speed. Silvered Soul is an offensive mobility passive; defense comes from timing Mirror Aegis.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Prismatic Lance · Aura: 650 · Cooldown: 3 s · Raw damage: 320 first hit; 180 each secondary hit
Damage listed here is before native combat handling and uses 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. EP never multiplies their damage.

sections.title: Prismatic Lance
lines: Raw damage: 320 first hit; 180 each secondary hit
Aim a light lance up to 32 blocks. On an initial hit, split toward up to two additional enemies within eight blocks of that victim.

sections.title: Mirror Aegis
lines: Damage type: None — reflected projectiles retain their own attack type

For six seconds, orbit mirror shards around yourself. Hostile or ownerless projectiles within 3.5 blocks that are moving toward you are redirected toward their previous owner, or backward if ownerless.

entries.title: Rune Smith
entries.summary: Rune Smith is a Unique Skill focused on armed proximity trap and remote demolition.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 50% Earth, Flame and Lightning boost through native attributes. No passive stacks are accumulated.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Runic Mine · Aura: 500 · Cooldown: 6 s · Raw damage: 300 on trigger
2. Command Detonation · Aura: 600 · Cooldown: 4 s · Raw damage: 450
Damage listed here is before native combat handling and uses 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. EP never multiplies their damage.

sections.title: Runic Mine
lines: Place one rune at your crosshair within 28 blocks, using a visible target or bounded surface/endpoint. It arms after one second and lasts fifteen seconds.

sections.title: Command Detonation
lines: Detonate your existing rune within 48 blocks, expanding its blast radius to six blocks and raising its raw damage to 450. You can detonate before proximity arming completes.

entries.title: Scarlet Deluge
entries.summary: Scarlet Deluge is a Unique Skill inspired by Uth Duna. It combines travelling currents, aimed whirlpools, and native barriers.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Effect: Retaliation deals water elemental damage; the barrier itself deals none.
While toggled on, gain 10 armor, 18 physical barrier, 18 magic barrier and 50% water boost. These native attributes participate in Tensura’s damage handling and visible barrier layer.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Crushing Current · Aura: 500 · Cooldown: 3 s · Raw opening damage: 250
2. Scarlet Undertow · Aura: 1,200 · Cooldown: 6 s · Raw opening damage: 100
Damage calculation: multiply the listed base values by 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, up to 1.50×. Elemental boosts, defenses, barriers, and situational modifiers also apply.

sections.title: Crushing Current
lines: It carries and drenches each enemy it reaches, damaging a given entity at most once per wave. Its front is 4 blocks wide on either side.

sections.title: Scarlet Undertow
lines: Place a six-second whirlpool at the aim point, up to 24 blocks away along the crosshair ray. The radius is 9 blocks.

entries.title: Storm Crown
entries.summary: Storm Crown is a Unique Skill inspired by Rey Dau. It combines ricochet lightning with an aimed movement art.

sections.title: Passive
lines: While toggled on, gain 6 armor, 35% movement, 25% attack speed and 50% lightning boost. Movement generates no resource.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Railbolt · Aura: 600 · Cooldown: 3 s · Raw opening damage: 300
2. Thunder Step · Aura: 700 · Cooldown: 4 s · Raw opening damage: 200
Damage calculation: multiply the listed base values by 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, up to 1.50×. Elemental boosts, defenses, barriers, and situational modifiers also apply.

sections.title: Railbolt
lines: Aim the first hit along a block-clipped ray up to 36 blocks. The bolt then ricochets from its latest victim to the nearest eligible enemy within twelve blocks.
The initial shot needs a clear path. Ricochets ignore blocks and never revisit a target.

sections.title: Thunder Step
lines: Dash along your full aim direction for up to 16 blocks, including upward and downward, and shock enemies within 2.5 blocks of the travelled segment. The path sweeps the caster’s whole bounding box in half-block increments; walls, low ceilings, collisions the world border and build-height limits stop it.

entries.title: Thoth, God of Magic
entries.summary: Thoth, God of Magic is a Godly Skill focused on elemental sequences, disruption, conversion and autonomous spell fire.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Resource: Magicules; Mana Crucible converts aura
Method: Mastered combination Ultimate + mastered Rune Smith; true awakening; 12M total EP

sections.title: Classification passives
lines: Owning Thoth automatically grants Divine Authority, Absolute Penetration and Interference Immunity: +35% damage against non-Godly owners, resistance/nullification bypass for your own damage, and protection against non-Godly Magic Interference. They have no toggle or upkeep and do not stack with Aion's shared traits.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 75% Earth, Flame, Water/Ice, Wind, Light, Lightning and Space boost; 75% increased native Chant Speed; and 25% reduced native Magic Cost Multiplier. Thoth’s Godly boosts apply in addition to the strongest ordinary elemental source.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Lexicon of Ruin · Magicules: 12,000 · Cooldown: 12 s · Raw damage: 1,100 per chapter
2. Spellbreak · Magicules: 6,500 · Cooldown: 15 s · Raw damage: 900
3. Mana Crucible · Magicules: 0; converts aura while held · Cooldown: None
4. Astral Library · Magicules: 24,000 · Cooldown: 35 s · Raw damage: 800 per bolt
Damage listed here is before native combat handling and uses 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. EP never multiplies their damage.

sections.title: Lexicon of Ruin
lines: Damage type: Fire, Water, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Light and Space elemental

Mark a six-block-radius spell diagram within 64 blocks. Seven chapters strike the fixed location at 0.60, 0.90, 1.25, 1.60, 1.90, 2.25 and 2.60 seconds, cycling Fire → Water → Lightning → Earth → Wind → Light → Space.

sections.title: Spellbreak
lines: Place a twelve-block-radius disruption field within 36 blocks, affecting up to six visible enemies. Each takes generic magic damage.

sections.title: Mana Crucible
lines: Resource cost: 2 aura per 1 magicule restored; no activation cost
Conversion speed: 5% of maximum magicules per second
Duration / total conversion limit: None; hold to continue
Hold the assigned skill key to continuously convert 2 current aura into 1 magicule. Restore 5% of maximum magicules per second, transferred smoothly each server tick.

sections.title: Astral Library
lines: Damage type: Rotating Fire, Water, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Light and Space elemental
For ten seconds, three open grimoires orbit above you. Starting after half a second and then every 0.25 seconds, fire at up to three visible enemies within 28 blocks.

entries.title: Threadweaver
entries.summary: Threadweaver is a Unique Skill focused on single-target leash and spatial severance.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 30% movement speed and 25% attack speed. This creates no charges or passive stacks.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Loom Needle · Aura: 500 · Cooldown: 4 s · Raw damage: 320
2. Sever Thread · Aura: 850 · Cooldown: 6 s · Raw damage: 550

sections.title: Loom Needle
lines: Aim at one visible enemy within 28 blocks. The hit pins a silk anchor at its current position for six seconds.

sections.title: Sever Thread
lines: Consume your live tether and burst around its current victim, hitting up to six eligible enemies in a four-block radius. The victim must remain within 40 blocks and visible.

sections.title: Passive
lines: Increase native spiritual-health regeneration by 100%. This modifies natural recovery; it does not create an additional periodic HP-heal loop.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Living Grove · Aura: 600 + healing expenditure · Cooldown: 14 s

sections.title: Living Grove
lines: Resource cost: 600 aura to place; each pulse pays for HP/SHP restored
Grow a stationary grove within 24 blocks. For eight seconds it restores 7% maximum HP and 6% maximum SHP each second to up to eight beneficiaries within seven blocks.

sections.title: Briar Grasp
lines: Lash up to six visible enemies in a forward fan within twelve blocks. Successful hits attempt to apply native Webbed for 3.5 seconds.

entries.title: Vritra, Lord of Cataclysm
entries.summary: Vritra, Lord of Cataclysm is an Ultimate Skill focused on piercing plasma, delayed fire and travelling demolition.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Method: Synthesis: master both ingredients; 2M total EP

sections.title: Passive
lines: Gain 100% Flame boost, 100% Lightning boost and 50% attack damage.

sections.title: Active
lines: 1. Plasma Bore · Aura: 6,000 · Cooldown: 5 s · Raw damage: 1,500 lightning; 850 per fire fuse
2. Thunderhead Crucible · Aura: 15,000 · Cooldown: 16 s · Raw damage: 900 lightning + 500 fire per pulse
3. Cataclysm Front · Aura: 25,000 · Cooldown: 26 s · Raw damage: 1,800 per eruption; 2,400 when empowered
Damage listed here is before native combat handling and uses 1 + 0.5 × mastery fraction, capped at 1.5×. EP never multiplies their damage.

sections.title: Plasma Bore
lines: Damage type: Lightning elemental + delayed Fire elemental
Raw damage: 1,500 lightning; 850 per fire fuse

Fire a solid-block-clipped plasma lance for 64 blocks, piercing up to eight visible enemies. While your thunderhead exists within 64 blocks, a second lance fires from its elevated center toward the same endpoint, clipped along its own route.

sections.title: Thunderhead Crucible
lines: Damage type: Lightning elemental + delayed Fire elemental
Raw damage: 900 lightning + 500 fire per pulse

Place an eleven-block-radius storm furnace within 48 blocks for eight seconds. Once per second it strikes up to six visible enemies with lightning; each strike leaves a fire burst at that position after 0.6 seconds, in a three-block radius.

sections.title: Cataclysm Front
lines: Raw damage: 1,800 per eruption; 2,400 when empowered
Send seven warned eruptions forward at four-block spacing, reaching 28 blocks. Each covers a 4.5-block radius.

entries.title: Hunter lineage
entries.summary: An alternate Human branch: Awakened Hunter → Apex Hunter → Sovereign Hunter.

sections.title: Requirements
lines: Awakened Hunter: 100,000 total EP and 1 distinct boss type.
Apex Hunter: 400,000 total EP and 3 distinct boss types.
Sovereign Hunter: 2,000,000 total EP, 5 distinct boss types and one mastered Myths Unique.

sections.title: Rewards
lines: HP / SHP bonuses: +100 / +400; +500 / +3,200; +1,000 / +6,600. The new stage replaces the old racial bonuses. Each stage grants the corresponding aura recovery skill.

sections.title: Boss credit
lines: Repeated kills of one boss type give one entry. Player-attributed kills while Human or a hunter count. Wither, Ender Dragon and supported boss-tagged mobs qualify.

entries.title: Skill synthesis
entries.summary: Skill synthesis combines two mastered Unique Skills into one new Ultimate. It is available to any race at 2,000,000 total EP.

sections.title: Recipes
lines: Vritra · Mastered ingredient 1: Storm Crown · Mastered ingredient 2: Black Flame · Role: Plasma / delayed demolition
Demeter · Mastered ingredient 1: Verdant Keeper · Mastered ingredient 2: Frostbound Colossus · Role: Allied support / crystal control
Janus · Mastered ingredient 1: Threadweaver · Mastered ingredient 2: Mirrorbound · Role: Gates / spatial displacement
Anansi · Mastered ingredient 1: Threadweaver · Mastered ingredient 2: Rune Smith · Role: Runic threads / triangular traps
Aegir · Mastered ingredient 1: Scarlet Deluge · Mastered ingredient 2: Mirrorbound · Role: Water refraction / tidal shock front

sections.title: Using the menu
lines: Open Skills → Ultimate, then choose Synthesis at the top of the native skill page. The native list still shows your learned Uniques and their details.
The server checks the complete recipe and EP requirement. An invalid request consumes nothing.

sections.title: Further evolution
lines: Master the resulting Ultimate, become a True Hero or True Demon Lord and reach 12M total EP. Skills → Godly → Ascension offers Aion, or Thoth when a mastered Rune Smith is also available.

sections.title: Standalone Uniques
lines: All Uniques remain usable independently. Scarlet Deluge combines with Mirrorbound into Aegir; Rune Smith combines with Threadweaver into Anansi.

sections.title: Godly choices
lines: At 12M total EP with true awakening, ascend a mastered Ultimate into Aion. Thoth also needs mastered Rune Smith; Lugh also needs mastered Threadweaver.

entries.title: Duo Races
entries.summary: Duo Races let an awakened player develop a second ancestral race alongside their primary race. The primary race retains the body, size and normal racial key.

sections.title: Unlock
lines: Finish your primary race, become a True Hero or True Demon Lord, and reach 5M total EP. Choose a different ancestry in the right-side Secondary Race tab. Confirm carefully: the choice is permanent for this life.

sections.title: Develop the secondary
lines: The added EP gates are fixed: 7.5M, 10M, 12.5M, 15M for the first four evolutions. Meet the native requirements shown in the menu too.
The secondary gives half-strength racial attributes and +10% native EP gain. Its racial action can be bound separately in Controls. The primary keeps your body and ordinary racial key.

sections.title: Daemon naming
lines: Being named means receiving your own name through Tensura. Naming other mobs, mass naming, name tags and nicknames do not satisfy it.

sections.title: Next step
lines: Finish both lineages to unlock their Convergent Awakening. The right-side tabs show current eligibility.

entries.title: Convergent Awakening
entries.summary: Convergent Awakening unites two fully evolved lineages into a single registered race. There are 105 unique pairs among the fifteen supported ancestral families.

sections.title: Requirements
lines: Both selected races must reach final evolution. Be a True Hero or True Demon Lord.
Required total EP: the greater of 10M and 125% of the highest preceding evolution EP gate. This uses fixed lineage gates, not your current EP at selection.

sections.title: Awaken
lines: Use the right-side Convergent Awakening tab. It shows your exact requirement and the resulting race.
The fusion grants a one-time 25% increase to both base energy pools, replaces the prior racial attributes, refills health/energy and retains learned skills and +10% EP gain.

sections.title: Concordance Pulse
lines: Bind the secondary racial action to use the fused action. Restore 50% max HP and SHP and push nearby enemies. Cost: 1,500 aura; cooldown: 30 seconds. No direct damage.

entries.title: Ananke, the Unwritten End
entries.summary: Ananke, the Unwritten End is the first Myth of Tensura Myths: a six-winged arbiter that guards the final page of an unwritten world. It combines fixed, readable attack patterns with native Ultimate and Godly skills.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Classification: Myth boss; native True Demon Lord
Base melee damage: 180; native mob attack

sections.title: Summoning
lines: Dragon's Breath · Echo Shard: Nether Star · End Crystal: Dragon's Breath
End Crystal · Echo Shard: Echo Shard · End Crystal: End Crystal
Craft a Writ of Last Dawn (wildhunt:writoflastdawn) with this shaped recipe:
Use it on a lodestone with room for a 1.6-block-wide, 4.1-block-tall entity above it. Prepare at least 32 blocks of clear fighting space around the spawn and more room to retreat.

sections.title: Combat
lines: Sealed Testament · Entry condition: Initial life · Changes: Fatebreaker, six-star Starfall Canticle, Eventide Procession and melee
Unwritten Crown · Entry condition: First fatal defeat after regeneration fails · Changes: Faster decisions, eight-star Starfall, Astral Library and Spellbreak
Last Dawn · Entry condition: Second fatal defeat after regeneration fails · Changes: Fastest decisions; The Last Dawn joins the rotation
Damage type / Damage ID: None — recovery only
Recovery cadence: Native Instant Regeneration checks every ten ticks / half second
HP recovery: Attempts to restore all missing HP, within native limits and available magicules
SHP recovery: Native Infinite Regeneration also attempts to restore missing SHP
Ananke flies after valid targets, fights nearby players and retaliates when attacked. Its arena anchor limits valid targets to 72 blocks from the spawn.

Infinite Regeneration takes priority: while funded and able to prevent the incoming death, it keeps Ananke in the current phase and restores wounds using magicules. When it can no longer prevent a fatal defeat, Ananke enters the next phase and immediately refills HP, SHP, magicules and aura to their current maximums.

sections.title: Rewards
lines: A player-attributed kill drops one Dawn Testament (wildhunt:dawntestament) and 1–3 Nether Stars. The boss grants 1,500 base experience; the First Myth challenge advancement grants 2,000 experience.

Drink a Dawn Testament for 2.4 seconds to heal 50% maximum HP, restore 50% maximum SHP, and fill aura and magicules to their current native caps. HP healing uses the native heal event; SHP restores directly to its native pool.

lines: For a managed encounter, stand at the center of a prepared arena and run:
The profile is saved in the world's native data/bossfights/ configuration. Existing ananke profiles are not overwritten.

entries.title: Eschaton, the Last Myth
entries.summary: Eschaton, the Last Myth is the final boss of Tensura Myths. An Origin Sovereign with one billion EP, he commands the birth and destruction of worlds through Demiurge, Aion and Thoth.

sections.title: At a glance
lines: Classification: Final Myth; native True Demon Lord
Base melee damage: 2,600; native mob attack
Entity size: 2.6 blocks wide; 6.2 blocks tall

sections.title: Summoning
lines: Dragon's Breath · Nether Star: Dawn Testament · Beacon: Dragon's Breath
Beacon · Nether Star: Nether Star · Beacon: Beacon
The Dawn Testament is obtained from Ananke. Use the invitation on a beacon on Easy, Normal or Hard, with seven clear blocks above it and sufficient width.

sections.title: Forms
lines: I — Origin Sovereign · Entry: Initial summon · Combat changes: Crownless Edge, Astral Loom, Sevenfold Genesis, Thronefall, exchange and apocalypse

II — Crown of Ruin · Entry: First fatal defeat that regeneration cannot prevent · Combat changes: Two additional arms and crescent mantle unfold; Null Testament and World-Eater's Wake join the rotation; Thoth auxiliary casts
III — The Last Myth · Entry: Second fatal defeat that regeneration cannot prevent · Combat changes: Seven crown blades awaken; fastest decisions; Aion auxiliary casts join Thoth
Infinite Regeneration takes priority. Funded native regeneration can prevent death without spending a form.
The form change clears outstanding owned attacks and seals. It is triggered by fatal defeat, rather than a health percentage or elapsed time.

sections.title: Combat
lines: Crownless Edge · Damage type: Physical Aura Slash · Pattern / counterplay: Three timed fans; the middle reverses direction
Astral Loom · Damage type: Light elemental · Pattern / counterplay: Rotating rays with gaps between them
Sevenfold Genesis · Damage type: Fire, Water, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Light, Space · Pattern / counterplay: Seven individually warned and locked impact locations
Null Testament · Damage type: Space elemental · Pattern / counterplay: Three parallel spatial corridors; successful hits can apply Godly Magic Interference
World-Eater's Wake · Damage type: Darkness elemental · Pattern / counterplay: Three expanding hollow fronts; two opposing golden gaps in each
Primordial Exchange · Damage type: None · Pattern / counterplay: Paid aura-to-magicule conversion; interrupted channels lose their payment
Thronefall · Damage type: Earth elemental · Pattern / counterplay: Short ascent and a locked, warned landing zone
The End of All Myths · Damage type: Space elemental · Pattern / counterplay: Ten-second apocalypse; break seals to open refuges or interrupt it
Four bossbars at the upper right show HP, SHP, magicules and aura. Confirmed HP or SHP loss gives the model a red damage flash even with Pain Nullification.
Eschaton flies, pursues valid targets, uses paid collision-safe spatial movement and attacks at close range. Targets must remain within 112 blocks of his anchor.

sections.title: Native boss arena
lines: Ordinary ritual summons do not require this managed arena. Both approaches preserve native PvP, allied-target and participant checks.

sections.title: Rewards
lines: Crown of the Last Myth: One guaranteed; use once per player for 25,000,000 base EP and permanent +20% maximum HP and SHP modifiers
Origin Fragment: 6–12; four plus a Nether Star craft Last Convergence; four plus a Ghast Tear and Dragon's Breath craft a Dawn Testament
The Last Myth advancement: Challenge advancement; 5,000 XP
The crown preserves the player's native primary or convergent aura/magicule allocation ratio. Its permanent HP/SHP modifiers obey the player's normal native attribute limits.
